title: Toyota Recalls Certain MY2024-2027 Land Cruiser Vehicles

body_markdown:
**PLANO, Texas (Oct. 14, 2026)** — Toyota is conducting a safety recall involving certain model year 2024-2027 Land Cruiser models. Approximately 106,000 vehicles are involved in this recall in the U.S.


A fuel tube connection near the fuel tank on the subject vehicles could become disconnected, allowing fuel to leak until the engine in the hybrid system shuts off. A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire.


All known owners of the subject vehicles will be notified to return their vehicle to a Toyota dealer. Dealers will inspect the connection and install a supplemental clamp at this connection to prevent it from disconnecting or, if necessary, replace the resin fuel tube and install the clamp, at no cost.


Owners of involved vehicles will be notified by mid-December 2026.


Information about automotive recalls, including but not limited to the list of involved vehicles, is current as of today’s filing date and is subject to change thereafter. To see if your vehicle is involved in a safety recall visit Toyota.com/recall or nhtsa.gov/recalls and enter your Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) or license plate information.


For any additional questions, Toyota customer support is also available by calling the Toyota Brand Engagement Center (1-800-331-4331).
